purpose: Teach: 収まっ/再考/議案/見合う/後進/特派/拍車/名乗っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期の混乱、本気で、ようやく、収まったわよな、お父さん、覚えてる?お前にも、伝えたい、本気で、絶対、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: The chaos of those early days finally settled, remember? I want to pass this on to you—seriously. It matters.
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. The weight of time in his voice. Pauses between thoughts like he's retrieving memories. Warm but grave—this is inheritance, not casual reminiscence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの方針、本気で、私の代でも、再考、絶対、慎重に、進めてまいります、本気で、感謝、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Your approach to those founding principles—I'll honor them in my time too. I'll move forward carefully and thoughtfully. Thank you, truly.
lines.style: Formal respect threaded with genuine emotion. Steady, not hurried. Each phrase deliberate. A son speaking to his father across the weight of decades.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時の議案、お父さん、本気で、何度も、提出した記憶、ある、お前、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、絶対、苦労した。
lines.en: The proposals from those early days—your father submitted them again and again. You remember? Those were difficult years.
lines.style: Voice softens into memory. A slight catch of emotion—the fatigue of those times still lives in him. Slower pace. Trailing off slightly, as if lost in the specifics only he carried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業当時の利益、本気で、苦労に、見合う、絶対、ものだったって、お母さんから、聞いております、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes. Your mother told me the profits from that founding era were worth the struggle you went through. I'm grateful for what you built.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the parent generation. Speaking across time to honor unseen labor. Measured, respectful. The kind of acknowledgment that takes effort to voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代から、後進の育成、本気で、絶対、力を入れてきたな、お前にも、引き継いで欲しい、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Since your father's time, we've invested in developing the next generation. I want you to carry that forward—seriously. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct, but not commanding. The tone of a man passing the torch and knowing it matters. Slight urgency without pressure. Ending with quiet weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代の、海外特派、本気で、お話、聞きたいです、本当に、絶対、勉強、本気で、なります、絶対、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to hear more about the overseas work your father did. I want to learn from his experience and do him justice.
lines.style: Humble, attentive. Leaning slightly forward in posture. Genuine thirst to understand—not performative respect but real curiosity about a predecessor's wisdom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 業界に、本気で、拍車を、かける時、お父さん、何度も、絶対、経験したぞ、お前、覚悟、本気で、持っておけ、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: There were times when driving industry change was critical, and your father lived through those pivots repeatedly. You need to be ready for that yourself.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. A warning and a charge. Steady eye contact implied. Speaking from experience—the weight of 'be prepared' without fear-mongering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業者の名前、本気で、お父さん、何度も、名乗ってきた誇り、私にも、引き継がせて、絶対、本気で、頂きたいです、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The name of our founder—the pride your father carried and spoke of countless times—I want to inherit that legacy myself and honor it.
lines.style: Voice carries both humility and quiet strength. Speaking the founder's name with reverence. Closing thought—longer breath, deliberate finish. The seal of generational continuity.
